note: BERC's interest on working capital for a distribution licensee (Reg. 26 as the FY2026-27 order for NBPDCL and SBPDCL quotes and summarises it) — the engine's sixth commission.

rules.title: Working capital before deductions: 45 days of revenue and spares

clause.excerpt: Regulation 26 as the order quotes and summarises it (pp.469–470): 45 days equivalent of expected revenue and 40 % of one month of R&M expense, less the power purchase cost with transmission and load despatch charges for one month, depreciation, RoE and contribution to contingency reserve for 45 days, and consumer security deposits; '… Provided also that if the State Government is providing resource gap grant and/or direct subsidy to consumers, the working capital shall be reduced by 45 days equivalent of that amount.'  The rate: the SBI one-year MCLR plus 150 basis points.

rules.note: the excerpt is the order's own quotation and summary of Reg. 26 (NBPDCL & SBPDCL FY2026-27 order, pp.469–470), not read from the Regulations
